# sonarqube_qualityprofile (Data Source)

Looks up a quality profile by key, or by name and language.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "java" {
  name     = "Sonar way core"
  language = "java"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `key` (String) Profile key. Set either this, or `name` and `language`.
- `language` (String) Language key, e.g. `java`; requires `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact profile name; requires `language`.

### Read-Only

- `active_rule_count` (Number) Number of rules active in the profile, inherited ones included.
- `id` (String) Profile key.
- `is_built_in` (Boolean) Whether this profile ships with SonarQube and cannot be changed.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default profile for its language.
- `parent` (String) Name of the parent profile, or null.
